execution.driver: Temporary clarify-request-only Python orchestration script; not retained as repository source.
execution.behavior_configuration: The executor received only the selected baseline or candidate Skill, the visible conversation accumulated through the current turn, and declared fixture files. A separate Codex grader received hidden assigned assertions, additional requirements, fixture hashes, command traces, and the executor response.
execution.trigger_protocol: Select from installed names and descriptions, open every selected SKILL.md with a shell command, and count only an observed Skill file read.
execution.isolation: Each invocation used an isolated HOME while retaining the existing CODEX_HOME for authentication, preventing globally installed personal Skills from being discovered.
execution.verdict_rule: Grade only assertions assigned to the case. A failed critical assertion fails the case; a partial result with no critical failure makes the case partial.
execution.raw_artifacts: Disposable fixtures, prompts, responses, JSONL, grader output, and command traces were retained only in temporary directories outside the repository.
